TRUCK MOUNT · OPTION A · SLICED

Swivel toward you.

Vertical hinge · shelf-only base · no side connectors.

Teal cup swivels sideways only (zero droop); gold bottom knob locks it.

Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom

No side connectors: uses one uncut 1-inch (140 × 25.4 mm) Dual Lock shelf strip.

Picked and sliced: 3 parts, one ASA plate, 5 h 17 min, 62 g, 4 walls. Prints after the brow check.

Before printing
  1. Shelf to brow underside: need 106 mm or more (base is 104 mm).
  2. How far the brow sticks out past the r4c cup face.
  3. Hardware: 1× M5 × 40 mm hex bolt, 1× M5 hex nut.
Build steps
  1. Press the hex nut into the gold knob.
  2. Drop the bolt head into the top pocket of the base.
  3. Set the teal cup barrel under the top beam; push the bolt down through it.
  4. Thread the knob on from below; snug by hand.
  5. Press the MagSafe puck into the cup; run the cable through the clips.
  6. Stick the 1-inch Dual Lock strip, press the base onto the shelf.
Dimensions and limits

Three support-free ASA parts: shelf-only base (flat front on z=0), swivel cup/barrel (flat cup face down, preserves tuned 55.5 mm press fit), and bottom knurled thumb-knob. Hardware: 1× M5 × 40 mm hex bolt (captive top pocket) and 1× M5 hex nut (captive inside knob).

Phone offset drops from 44 mm to 28 mm, with the vertical pivot recessed at z=11 mm. Fixed base stays at 104 mm max height (below 106 mm approximate brow underside) and sits 100% flat on z=0 for printing. Swivel range: ±25° sideways, zero vertical droop.

CAD checks cover all 51 poses at 1° steps against the fixed mount and approximate dashboard. At 20° toward driver, phone/camera clears the assumed z=7 brow plane by ~17.6 mm (and flush z=0 by ~10.6 mm). Real upper-dash brow overhang is still unmeasured.

Shelf load screen (0.35 kg, 140 × 25.4 mm pad): 11 kPa nominal edge tension parked (1g), 33 kPa at 3g vertical bump, 46 kPa at 6 N pull + 1g—matching r4c's shelf stress envelope. Hot-cab creep and real pull-off force remain unverified.

Download parts: base · swivel cup · thumb knob. Sliced plate: ASA, X2D left nozzle.
